iron.blurb: A Phrygian, half-time stomp, metal and anvils, no lead line.

hollow.blurb: F minor doom. Half-time, one event a bar, enormous. Build-up is subtraction: the settle strips to a held sub and a ghost riser, so the countdown toms land out of near-silence.

sources.reverse: C:\Program Files\Image-Line\FL Studio 2025\Data\Patches\Packs\SFX\FX Drone Strings Rev.wav

arcade.blurb: A minor chiptune. Square-wave bass and sixteenth arpeggios over a 707 kit. Build-up is an accelerating blip: the gap halves twice before the countdown, so the tension is rhythmic.

sources.square: C:\Program Files\Image-Line\FL Studio 2025\Data\Patches\Packs\SFX\SFX Big Square Drop.wav

prowl.blurb: C# minor trap. Half-time, 808s that slide into pitch. Build-up is hat rolls subdividing eighths to sixteenths to thirty-seconds, so the tension is in the hats rather than a riser.

rush.blurb: G minor drum'n'bass. Still 100 BPM — what reads as fast is a break on sixteenths and a ride on thirty-seconds over a half-time reese. Build-up is a snare roll halving its gap twice into the countdown.

sources.subdrop: C:\Program Files\Image-Line\FL Studio 2025\Data\Patches\Packs\SFX\SFX Bass Sweep Drop.wav

dub.blurb: Bb minor dub techno. One offbeat chord stab and eight decaying copies of it; the delay is the instrument. Build-up is the feedback climbing toward self-oscillation — the room filling up rather than a riser.

stalk.blurb: C minor in 12/8. Same 2.4s bar, divided into twelve instead of sixteen, so the pulse is triplet and the whole thing lopes. All toms and hands. Build-up subdivides 3 -> 6 -> 12.

sources.reverse: C:\Program Files\Image-Line\FL Studio 2025\Data\Patches\Packs\SFX\FX Drone Strings Rev.wav

neon.blurb: F# minor synthwave. Sixteenth arpeggio that never stops, gated snare, saw lead. Build-up climbs the arp an octave while the filter opens — brighter rather than louder.

grit.blurb: E minor boom-bap. Swung sixteenths, top rolled off so it sounds sampled rather than programmed. Build-up straightens the swing — the shuffle disappears bar by bar until the countdown is dead on the grid.

maw.blurb: D minor dubstep. Half-time, and the bass is the melody rather than the floor. Build-up speeds the wobble up — two cycles a bar, then four, then eight — so the tension is the bass losing its mind.

sources.radio: C:\Program Files\Image-Line\FL Studio 2025\Data\Patches\Packs\SFX\SFX Radio FM Drop.wav

drift.blurb: A Lydian ambient. The only major-key track and the only one with no aggression in it. Build-up is proximity, not volume: the drone rises, the bells thin out, and the countdown is three soft bells.

odd.blurb: B minor in 5/4. Same 2.4s bar, five beats of 0.48s instead of four of 0.6, grouped 3+2 so it limps. Build-up flips the grouping to 2+3, which is unsettling in a way a riser cannot be.

rally.blurb: A minor uplifting trance. Sixteenth arp throughout, offbeat bass, and a supersaw lead that is the point. Build-up is the classic — drums out, lead alone, gate opening into the drop.

candy.blurb: D minor UK hardcore. Distorted kick, piano riff on eighths, sixteenth kick rolls in the fills. Build-up accelerates the riff and climbs the hoover.

relay.blurb: Db major future bass. Bright and warm rather than dark; the hook is a chord that bends into pitch. Build-up climbs the chord a semitone at a time, so the run-in is harmonic rather than rhythmic.

spark.blurb: C minor electro house. Filtered chord stabs and a bassline that walks rather than pedals. Build-up opens the filter across four hits of the same chord.

glory.blurb: E minor festival big-room. One lead melody stated plainly with everything out of its way — rally's opposite, which hides its tune inside an arpeggio. Build-up strips to a single held note.

disco.blurb: A minor nu-disco. The bass walks in octaves — the one groove here that is funky rather than driving. Build-up climbs the string stabs and doubles the tambourine, so it lifts rather than tightens.

kite.blurb: F# minor melodic dubstep. Half-time weight under a lead trying to be pretty rather than ugly — maw's opposite number. Build-up plays the hook once unaccompanied before the drop takes it.

liquid.blurb: Bb minor liquid drum'n'bass. The same double-time surface as rush with none of the menace — warm pads, rolling sub, bells. Build-up opens the pad and creeps the break in underneath.

sources.subdrop: C:\Program Files\Image-Line\FL Studio 2025\Data\Patches\Packs\SFX\SFX Bass Sweep Drop.wav

shuffle.blurb: G minor UK garage two-step. The kick skips beat 3 entirely and the sixteenths swing hard. Build-up deepens the swing rather than straightening it — grit's build in reverse.

choir.blurb: D minor orchestral. Taiko and voices, no drum kit at all. Build-up is a crescendo: the choir swells continuously while the toms double and double again, so the tension is dynamic.

note: Percussion, risers and FX are FL Studio factory samples; tonal layers are synthesised in tools/build_music.py. Every track renders the same stem lengths off the same grid, so the game can pick any of them per match without a timing changing.
